{{Top}}
The '''Republic Treasury''' was responsible for ensuring the financial viability of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its primary form of currency, the datarie or [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credit]]. Within its organization was a complete [[Republic Treasury Audit Division|Audit Division]], that ensured all member corporations and governments&mdash;including the Republic itself&mdash;followed the proper accounting procedures and regulations. Each branch of the Republic Treasury was allowed to enforce its own regulations, and many branches had dedicated investigative teams.
